title: Crayola Has Revealed Minnesota's Favorite Colors - NewsBreak
text:
By Carly Ross ,
11 hours ago
This is kind of weird, but when someone asks for my favorite color, I panic a little. My favorite color changes all the time! My go-to is always yellow because that’s what I would say as a kid, but I also love green, dusty pink, orange…
But Crayola has now revealed the world’s favorite color . Yes, the favorite color of the whole world! They also broke it down by the favorite colors in different countries and Minnesota’s favorite colors.
ALSO READ: Study Reveals Minnesota’s Favorite Donut
People from around the world voted on Crayola’s website for their favorite Crayola colors as part of their first-ever ‘World’s Favorite Crayola Color Vote’, and we now have the top 3.
Let’s take a peek at those before we get to Minnesota’s favorite colors.
Download the KROC Mobile App Now The World’s Favorite Colors According to Crayola Based on the votes, the world’s favorite colors are Wisteria at number 3, Robin’s Egg Blue at number 2, and the world’s favorite color is Cerulean.
Canva All three of those are so pretty!
Now let’s see how that compares to our favorite colors in the Land of 10,000 Lakes. There is some overlap!
Minnesota’s Favorite Colors According to Crayola Minnesota’s favorite colors are actually all different shades of blue. This could be a color scheme for a room or something, they all look great together.
Our 3rd favorite color is Blue Green.
Canva Our 2nd favorite color is Robin’s Egg Blue.
Canva And our number 1 favorite color is Cerulean. Clearly a very popular pick!
Canva MN Cold War Missile Site Turned Home for Sale in Castle Rock A former Cold War missile site in Castle Rock Township, Minnesota has been converted into a livable property and is now for sale. Gallery Credit: Carly Ross Andy and Jamie Voyen, Edina Realty Former Missile Site Turned Home Welcome to the former NIKE Missile Launch Site from the Cold War. It was built to protect the Twin Cities during the Cold War Era. Now, the property and buildings have been converted into livable space, and it's now for sale for $2.25 million. (The listing agents are Andy and Jamie Voyen with Edina Realty.) Andy and Jamie Voyen, Edina Realty Main Home There's a main house and a guest house on this property (which is just over 26 acres). This is an outside look at the main home. Andy and Jamie Voyen, Edina Realty Main Home Entry In here, you would have no idea this place used to house missiles! The main home has 3 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms. It's 3,500 sqft. Andy and Jamie Voyen, Edina Realty Open Concept Living The living area is a super open concept. You can see the living room, dining room, and kitchen all from here. Andy and Jamie Voyen, Edina Realty Bedroom Here's a peek at the main bedroom. Andy and Jamie Voyen, Edina Realty Bathroom And this is a peek at the main bathroom, which has this incredible shower! The listing says the home has "splashes of Moroccan inspiration throughout", which you can definitely see here. Andy and Jamie Voyen, Edina Realty Guest House Now, let's move on to the guest house, which has 4 more bedrooms and is 3,000 sqft. That big chunk on the left is a huge garage area. The other half on the right is the living space. Andy and Jamie Voyen, Edina Realty Inside the Guest House The guest house, for me personally, seems more homey. And I suppose whoever owns this property next could decide if this house will be their main home or the other one! Andy and Jamie Voyen, Edina Realty Another Living Area Here's another living area in the guest house. Andy and Jamie Voyen, Edina Realty Guest House Kitchen The kitchen in the guest house is modest. Definitely not nearly as fancy as the main house. Andy and Jamie Voyen, Edina Realty Guest House Bedroom And here's a peek at one of the bedrooms in the guest house. Andy and Jamie Voyen, Edina Realty Former Mess Hall Moving on to the former mess hall, this space was turned into an amazing place for throwing parties. Also, the garden out front is amazing! Andy and Jamie Voyen, Edina Realty Former Mess Hall Check out all that space! It looks so cool! And that spiral staircase... Andy and Jamie Voyen, Edina Realty Rooftop Views Leads up to this rooftop overlook area. And yes, you can go out onto the roof to take in the amazing views. Andy and Jamie Voyen, Edina Realty Commercial-Grade Kitchen There's also a commercial-grade kitchen in the former mess hall. This place could totally be rented out for events. Andy and Jamie Voyen, Edina Realty The Bunker And finally, of course, a former missile site has a bunker. Andy and Jamie Voyen, Edina Realty Inside the Bunker If you aren't a doomsday prepper, I'm not totally sure what you'd do with this space, but there are lots of options. Andy and Jamie Voyen, Edina Realty Movie Theater It appears the current owner has been using the bunker as a movie theater, which I think is awesome! Andy and Jamie Voyen, Edina Realty Former Missile Site Turned Home So, what do you think? There are a total of 11 buildings on the property, but not all of them are renovated. That could be a project for whoever buys the place. Would you want to live in a former missile site?
